page.notes: Some readings are uncertain: "declinabiliter" (line 3) may be printed with a different letter form, and "Iudaei" may be "Iudæi". Long s is read as s throughout, so "veftris" and "infeftiffimum" are given as vestris and infestissimum, and "quaefo" as quaeso. Below the last line, at the left, there is a small stray mark ("/") that looks like printer's or show-through damage, not text, so it is left out. The page has no catchword. The word "derelin-" is hyphenated at the page end and continues on the next page.
